text: NASA expects the record to keep growing. Follow Downlink Cat to watch.
direction: You are a young, nerdy science creator in your early twenties, a little scrawny, filming a vertical video for your followers. Talk like a popular creator on TikTok or YouTube Shorts, not a narrator: conversational, a grin in your voice, genuinely hyped. Hit the hook hard, take a tiny beat before each reveal, punch the key words (out-drove, every, 28.10, 28.06, fifteen, five and a half, itself, 20, 600,000), speed up through setup lines and slow down on the payoff. Energy: high. A little more cat: a playful purr on a few r sounds and a small 'mrr'-like rise on the question line. Still natural, never a meow.
